Tokens

Material 3 Expressive's tokens in src/app/booster.css, section 1: color roles, the type scale, the shape scale, elevation, motion and state layers. Use a token, never a hex color or a px font size. The surfaces, the text colors and the status colors are fixed, the same for every club; the club's color seeds the primary, secondary and tertiary roles (Club scheme, below).

color: var(--on-surface-variant); padding: var(--s3) var(--s4); border-radius: var(--shape-l-inc); font: var(--title-m);

Fixed color roles (light / dark)

--ground#eceef2 / #111316--surface#f7f9fd / #111316--card#ffffff / #1e2022--surface-container-lowest#ffffff / #0c0e12--surface-container-low#f1f4f7 / #1a1c1e--surface-container#eceef2 / #1e2022--surface-container-high#e6e8ec / #282a2d--surface-container-highest#e0e3e6 / #333538--on-surface#1a1c1e / #e0e3e6--on-surface-variant#42474e / #c1c7cf--outline#72777f / #8b9199--outline-variant#c1c7cf / #42474e--done#1f6b3d / #6cc38a--done-container#e3f2e8 / #12301f--due#9a4a0b / #f2b36b--due-container#fdeedc / #3a2510--late#a1231a / #ff8a80--late-container#fbe4e2 / #3d1512--info#3b4cb8 / #a5adff--info-container#e6e8fa / #1e2250--neutral-container#e6e8ec / #282a2d--badge-ink#6b6b6b / #9a9aa2

The club's roles (made from its color at runtime)

--primaryThe club's, in this mode--on-primaryThe club's, in this mode--primary-containerThe club's, in this mode--on-primary-containerThe club's, in this mode--secondaryThe club's, in this mode--on-secondaryThe club's, in this mode--secondary-containerThe club's, in this mode--on-secondary-containerThe club's, in this mode--tertiaryThe club's, in this mode--on-tertiaryThe club's, in this mode--tertiary-containerThe club's, in this mode--on-tertiary-containerThe club's, in this mode--focusThe ring: primary, or on-surface--seedThe exact color: the logo tile alone

Type scale (M3, emphasized, in Inter)

--display-s 2.25rem, 600: a staff page's title from 840px

--headline-l 2rem, 650: a page's title on a phone

--headline-m 1.75rem, 650: a stat

--headline-s 1.5rem, 600: a sheet's or dialog's title

--title-l 1.375rem, 600: a card's title, the club's name

--title-m 1rem, 600: a list row's title, a Medium button

--title-s 0.875rem, 600: table headers, section labels, the rail's groups

--body-l 1rem, 400: body text, the least a phone ever reads

--body-m 0.875rem, 400: a meta line, a card's quiet line, table cells

--label-l 0.875rem, 600: buttons, nav links, field labels

--label-m 0.8125rem, 600: status labels and tab labels, the floor (M3's 12px, raised)

Shape

--shape-xs4px: fields--shape-s8px: status labels, a pressed button--shape-m12px: the logo tile--shape-l16px: notices, a side sheet's edge, choice tiles--shape-l-inc20px: cards, a list's ends--shape-xl28px: dialogs, the staff pane--shape-full buttons, the tab pill, the bulk bar, avatars

Space, elevation, motion and states

Space: --s1 4px, --s2 8px, --s3 12px, --s4 16px, --s5 24px, --s6 32px, --s7 48px (M3's 4px grid); the page gutter --cell is 16px compact and 24px from 600px. Breakpoints are M3's window classes: 600, 840 and 1200px.

Elevation is tone first: a card is a surface container on the page, with no shadow. Only what floats has one, --shadow-3: the bulk bar, dialogs, side sheets and menus.

--shadow-3: the floating bulk bar

Motion: springs for what moves (a button's corner on press, sheets and the dialog coming in, the tab pill, the bulk bar), --spring-fast and --spring-default; color and opacity on --effects over 150ms, never bouncing. Text never moves. With reduced motion nothing moves at all.

States: hover washes the content color over the container at 8% (--sl-hover), a press at 10% (--sl-press). Every control and lone link is at least --target, 48 by 48. Focus: every ring is --ring, 3px, in --focus (the club's primary, or on-surface where primary can't hold 3:1 off every surface), 2px clear of what it rings.

Club scheme

How a club's color becomes its palette (src/lib/theme/scheme.ts, Google's material-color-utilities): primary keeps the color's own strength at M3's fixed tones, so its contrast is the same for every club; secondary is the same hue, quiet; tertiary is the hue turned about 60 degrees. Light, dark and both high-contrast modes are all made from it. Try a color: nothing is saved.

import { clubScheme, clubCssVars } from "@/lib/theme/scheme";
Try a color

The logo tile keeps the exact color, #1e1b4b, with #ffffff on it. Everything else is the scheme below.

Button and LinkButton

Button does something; LinkButton goes somewhere. M3 Expressive's set: filled (the club's primary, one per area), tonal (a row's action, a second action), outlined (a secondary action standing alone), text (the least: Cancel, Clear, Not now), danger (removes or ends something, in the late color) and danger-filled (that action inside its ConfirmDialog). Fully round; the corner squares off a little while pressed. Small (sm, md) is drawn 40px tall inside a 48px target; lg is M3's medium, 56px, for a page's main button and sheet and dialog footers. Busy is aria-disabled with a spinner, never disabled, on parent pages.

import { Button, LinkButton } from "@/app/components/ui";
Pay

Hover washes the button's own ink over its fill at 8%, a press at 10%. Focus is the 3px ring, 2px clear of the fill, drawn here on the sample. A long label wraps inside the button:

Do: a button for anything that starts, changes or moves a task on

Next: connect to QuickBooksConnect a different company

Button submits a form; LinkButton goes to an action or the next step. Filled for the one thing the step is for, tonal or outlined for the others.

Don't: an underlined link for an action or a step

Skip to step 3 · Connect a different company

A plain link is only for reading more, help, going back to where you came from (“Back to Roster”), or a record's own page in a list or table. Alone on its line it takes .link-line.

Badge and StatusBadge

A status label: a state's icon and words on its tone's container (StatusBadge), or a short label (a role, a count). 8px corners, never fully round, so it never looks like a button or a chip. Never color alone: the words say it.

import { Badge, StatusBadge, StatusIcon } from "@/app/components/ui";
Paid2 to signOverdueWaiting for QuickBooksNot startedAdminNew
StatusIcon doneStatusIcon dueStatusIcon lateStatusIcon infoStatusIcon neutral

Card

A titled region of a page: what a family owes, its students, a setting. M3's filled card: its fill on the page's ground, 20px corners, no edge. Its title names the region for screen readers. Actions sit at the foot, or beside the title with headActions. tonal fills one region with the club's primary container (Home's new messages): at most one a page, never the money card. Never a card inside a card.

import { Card } from "@/app/components/ui";

Sample Family

A quiet line under the title

The card's content: words, a List, a DataTable or a form.

See your payments

A much longer title that has to wrap onto a second line on a phone

With headActions the action sits beside the title and wraps under it when there is no room.

1 new message from the club

A sample: the one region a page makes stand out.

Read it in Messages

List and ListRow

The core of the look: M3 Expressive's segmented list. Each row is its own tile, 2px apart, the group rounded at its ends; each a 40px status circle in its tone's container, its words, a title, a meta line, then an amount or a compact action. Use it for To do, Students, Payments and any short list a person acts on; ListTotal under a list of amounts sums them. A long list of records with columns is a DataTable.

import { List, ListRow, ListSubRow, ListTotal, SectionLabel } from "@/app/components/ui";

EmptyState

Where a list or table has nothing yet: say what will be here, kindly, and the one action that fills it.

import { EmptyState } from "@/app/components/ui";

No volunteer events yet

When you add one, families see it on their Volunteer page.

Drawer

A form behind a button: a repeated form on a row (Waive for…, Change the student…) or a secondary one on a page. The button says what the form does; it opens M3's modal side sheet from 600px wide (a full-screen sheet on a phone), with a close icon button and 56px buttons at its foot. It has its own address (?param=value): Back closes it, a refresh opens it again, and without JavaScript the button is a link to the page with the form drawn in it. The focus goes in, stays in, and comes back to the button; Esc and Close close it.

import { Drawer } from "@/app/components/ui";Change the event

Change the event

Close

Families see the new name and date at once.

ConfirmDialog

One press that needs a second look: a button with the action's words, then M3's basic dialog (28px corners, a centered title, the alert icon for a destructive one) with one sentence of what follows, an optional box to tick or a reason to type, and at its end Cancel, a text button that has the focus first, then the action's own button, filled. Not for a form: that is a Drawer.

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/app/components/ui";

Disconnect QuickBooks?

The portal stops reading QuickBooks. The last roster stays, marked as no longer current.

Remove this credit?

It stops counting toward what the club asks. Only staff see your reason.

StepsChoice

Two ways to do one task, such as by hand or with a script: M3 Expressive's connected button group in the open (the chosen one round, in the secondary container), the chosen way's one line under it, and only its steps below.

import { StepsChoice } from "@/app/components/ui";

Fields

TextInput, TextArea, Select and Checkbox, each with its label above it (never floating, never a placeholder), a hint and an error tied to the control with aria-describedby. Fields are M3's outlined field, 56px tall; tick boxes and radios are M3's, in a 48px target. ChoiceGroup for a few options that need explaining: a chosen tile turns the secondary container. The id comes from the page.

import { TextInput, TextArea, Select, Checkbox, ChoiceGroup } from "@/app/components/ui";

RichTextEditor

A body of rich text a person writes (a club message): its label and hint over a frame with the toolbar (undo and redo, two headings, two lists, bold, italic, underline, a link, and a picture where the form takes them) and the writing area. It offers only what src/lib/messages/body.ts keeps; the server checks what it sends. The form reads what was written through its ref. Tiptap, with the look of Tiptap's Simple Editor template. Not for a line of plain text: that is a TextInput or TextArea.

import { RichTextEditor, type RichTextHandle } from "@/app/components/rich-text-editor";
Message

Some words or a picture. Headings, bold, italic, underline, lists, links and pictures.

DataTable

Many records with the same columns: the roster, Balances, the audit log. M3 has no data table, so this is ours on M3's tokens: title-small headers on the highest container, rows at least 56px with a hover layer, a ticked row in the secondary container. Numbers right-aligned in tabular figures; a quiet column for row actions. Below 840px each row stacks, label beside value.

Bulk select

Inside BulkSelect, select puts a tick box on each row ("Select" and the row's name) and one in the header, mixed when some are ticked. M3 Expressive's floating toolbar stays in view while any are, a raised pill on the club's primary container: the count, read out as it changes, the actions, and Clear; with the page ticked and more rows matching, "Select all M that match". On a phone the actions are one "N selected · Actions" button. A bulk action sends selectionPayload(), ids from the browser: the server checks every one again before it acts, and works out "all that match" from its own query. Its Drawer says first what would happen to each row, then what did.

      Notice and ActionOutcome

      A status that stands apart: information, needs attention, done, a problem, on its tone's container with its icon and bold word (ours: M3 has no banner, and a snackbar never answers an action). ActionOutcome shows what a server action answered, in place. A problem is announced as an alert, the rest as a status. An answer that replaces the form that was pressed takes the focus: give it a ref (and Notice tabIndex={-1}).

      import { Notice, ActionOutcome } from "@/app/components/ui";

      LocalTime, CalendarDate and formatMoney

      An instant in the viewer's own time, a calendar date the same for everyone, and an amount in tabular figures. Never format these yourself.

      import { LocalTime, CalendarDate } from "@/app/components/ui"; import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/money/cents";

      Club bar, rail and tabs

      The frame every page sits in. ClubBar is M3's small top app bar, 64px: the club's logo tile in its exact color, its name, and the account. A parent's places are links in the bar from 840px (the current one on M3's pill) and M3's navigation bar at the foot below that, labels always shown. Staff have the expanded navigation rail from 1200px, always open, every group's pages under its heading, and below 1200px the same navigation bar with Home, the groups and Settings. The current place is the secondary container and bold, never the color alone. Drawn here as samples.

      import { ClubBar } from "@/app/components/club-bar"; import { StaffRail } from "@/app/components/top-nav";
